entities.name: Putative ribose-phosphate pyrophosphokinase
observations: 324-aa sequence; 51.0% identity and 95.4% query coverage to reviewed Fusobacterium nucleatum ribose-phosphate pyrophosphokinase Q8RHM2 (E-value 3e-107), supporting a putative EC 2.7.6.1 assignment.
Predicted domains: Pribosyltran_N PF13793 (residues 5–121), Pribosyltran PF00156 (150–250), and Pribosyl_synth PF14572 (205–311).
Sequence-derived estimates: 35,680.8 Da and theoretical pI 5.57.

entities.name: PRPP biosynthesis reaction
observations: Reference homolog annotation gives D-ribose 5-phosphate + ATP → 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate (PRPP) + AMP + H+; Rhea RHEA:15609. This reaction is inferred for the query from homology, not experimentally established here.
